cancellation.quote: Cancellation requests must be submitted at least 7 days before your next billing cycle to take effect in the current billing period.
cancellation.value: Cancellation requires at least seven days' notice before the next billing cycle. The terms state that cancellation must be handled by phone.

consultation_fee.quote: LevelsRx offers multiple subscription types, all of which include comprehensive coaching and services with no hidden fees, membership costs, or lab charges. Each plan provides regular virtual consultations with a clinician, prescription management and renewals (if applicable), support with insurance coverage for medications, and access to 1:1 nutritionist coaching, ongoing chat support, and health guides.
consultation_fee.value: Virtual clinician consultations are included in the subscription, with no separate membership or lab charge stated.

eligibility.quote: While prescriptions for weight loss medication cannot be guaranteed for every patient, if you are 18 years of age or older and meet specific criteria such as weight and certain associated health conditions, your healthcare provider may consider you eligible for a prescription.
eligibility.value: Patients must be at least 18 and satisfy clinician-reviewed weight and health criteria; prescriptions are not guaranteed.

first_month_price.value: UNKNOWN — compounded semaglutide starts at $150 per month, but the page does not label this amount as the exact first-month charge.

legitscript.value: The provider page displays the words LegitScript and Certified. Independent current registry status was not separately checked.
